title: Positive direct images of quasi-coherent tensor-sections sheaves vanish
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i:X.Opens\to X.Etale$ a continuous functor with $i\circ forget=X.restrictFunctor$. Let $T=i_*$ be continuous direct image [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], assumed additive. For every quasi-coherent $X$-module $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] and $n\in\mathbb N$, $R^{n+1}T(F_{et})=0$, where $F_{et}$ is the associated tensor-sections abelian sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. No global cohomology comparison or natural equivalence is asserted.

source.place: Proposition Tag 03DW (descent-proposition-same-cohomology-quasi-coherent), part (2); etale-cohomology.tex, Theorem Tag 03P2 (etale-cohomology-theorem-zariski-fpqc-quasi-coherent); sites-cohomology.tex, Tags 03F3, 072W and 0733(1)

proof.text: Apply positiveDirectImageOfObjectAcyclic in degree n+1 to the tensor-sections sheaf. Supply vanishing of its object cohomology on affine opens using etaleTensorPositiveObjectCohomology. The generic criterion proves local vanishing is sufficient, without asserting global object cohomology vanishing on arbitrary opens.

proof_origin.note: Second reading corrected the proposed all-open acyclicity to affine-open acyclicity and proved the generic affine-basis sheafification criterion.
